idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

run_side.prompt: Runs in place with long fast strides, its body leaning forward and its tail held straight out behind. It stays in place, facing right.

bite_side.prompt: Pulls its head back with its jaws open, then snaps its head forward and bites, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing right.

hurt_side.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing right.

death_side.prompt: Stumbles, its legs give way and it falls over onto its side, then lies still. It stays in place, facing right.

threat_side.prompt: Crouches, opens its jaws wide in a shrill screech and flicks its tail, then settles. It stays in place, facing right.
